full_name: Uri Alon | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2009–2010 Biological Sciences Grass Fellow Weizmann Institute of Science (Israel)
bio: Uri Alon is one of the pioneers of systems biology, a field that studies how the parts of cells work together to perform the functions of life.
